verses.text: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh, who walks in his ways.
lines: Blessed is everyone who fears Yahweh,

verses.text: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
lines: For you will eat the labor of your hands.
You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

verses.text: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive plants around your table.
lines: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house,
your children like olive plants around your table.

verses.text: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.
lines: Behold, thus is the man blessed who fears Yahweh.

verses.text: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
lines: May Yahweh bless you out of Zion,
and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

verses.text: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
lines: Yes, may you see your children’s children.
